issue: Laptop screen flickers after wake from sleep.
resolution: Support asked customer to update graphics driver, disable adaptive brightness, and test with an external monitor. Hardware review was offered when internal display remained unstable.

issue: Customer wants to return unopened headphones after 12 days.
resolution: Return approved because the item was unused and still within the 30-day return window.

issue: Order appears delayed with no movement for three days.
resolution: Support checked tracking, confirmed a carrier delay, and reassured the customer using the latest shipment update.

issue: Customer forgot laptop password and recovery key status is unknown.
resolution: Support directed the customer to Recovery Mode and explained that BitLocker recovery must be completed before password reset.

issue: Phone battery dropped below 80 percent capacity after nine months.
resolution: Battery replacement review approved under the one-year limited warranty after diagnostics.

issue: Customer demanded a manager after repeated troubleshooting did not fix display issues.
resolution: Case escalated to a human specialist and a high-priority ticket was opened.
